verdict.rationale: Teller documents a dedicated account balances endpoint that returns 'live, real-time account balances' (teller-docs-2). Its marketing explicitly positions 'guaranteed live account balances' for underwriting and for confirming sufficient funds before submitting an ACH debit, which matches the NSF/risk-check intent (teller-docs-22, teller-docs-1). missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of real-time freshness, and endpoint-level detail in the evidence (response fields, latency or cost of live refresh).
